272:t_009:40.en:
$$タケル$$
「If they're the ones standing in the way of humanity's future... If they're the fundamental calamity...!」

272:t_009:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll overcome them! With everything we've got!!」

272:t_010:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「A razor-thin victory, if ever there was one...」

272:t_010:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ and those monsters are a different breed from any $$サイデリアル$$ force we've faced so far.」

272:t_010:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「An enemy that shatters our hearts with dread... So that is the $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

272:t_010:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Our true enemy... Is that the fundamental calamity of humanity...?」

272:t_011:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「Their strength... is off the charts.」

272:t_011:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Those black $$アンゲロイ$$ and those monsters are a different breed from any $$サイデリアル$$ force we've faced so far!」

272:t_011:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「An enemy that shatters our hearts with dread... So that is the $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

272:t_011:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Our true enemy... Is that the fundamental calamity of humanity...!?」

272:t_012:0.en:
$$ダリー$$
「There are more of them than before...!」

272:t_012:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「No way...! How are we supposed to fight something like that!」

272:t_012:2.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Is this... as far as we go...」

272:t_012:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「N-No...! I don't want to die yet!」

272:t_012:5.en:
$$青山$$
(Sorry, Mom... I don't think I'm getting home...)

272:t_012:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
(So this is what the end is... It's over so easily...)

272:t_012:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't lose heart! It's far from over!」

272:t_012:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「You can give up and despair later! Right now, let's do what we have to do!」

272:t_012:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm doing this! I can still feel pain... I'm alive!!」

272:t_014:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「What...!? $$ガンレオン$$ is... crying!」

272:t_014:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait! Wasn't it you who sent us here in the first place!」

272:t_014:5.en:
???
「$$ウェルキエル・ザ・ヒート$$... You endure pain and fear...」

272:t_014:6.en:
???
「Someday, you will understand everything... And then, walking the path of $$シンカ$$, all the universes...」

272:t_015:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This is not good. The power section has taken a hit.」

272:t_015:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「In this battle... getting through unscathed looks impossible...」

272:t_016:0.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad, $$號$$! We can't shake the enemy off!」

272:t_016:2.en:
$$號$$
「We fight with everything we've got...! That's all we can do!」

272:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(I'm sorry, Miss $$美重子$$... I might not be able to graduate from elementary school after all...)

272:t_100:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(But I... I want to see everyone again...! That's why... that's why!!)

272:t_101:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
(Maybe now I won't have to worry about the company going bankrupt anymore...)

272:t_101:1.en:
$$厚井$$
($$竜介$$... Take care of your mother for me...)

272:t_101:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
(Fighting an enemy like that in a shuttle... There's just no way...)

272:t_101:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「...But everyone...! With the President fighting, we, his subordinates, cannot possibly retreat!」

272:t_101:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「L-Let's go! No matter who the enemy is, as employees of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$!」

272:t_102:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
($$鉄人$$ is a robot, so he doesn't lose to fear...)

272:t_102:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(If I, the one piloting him, am afraid, it'll only put $$鉄人$$ in danger...! Scared or not... I have no choice but to do it!)

272:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't flinch, $$オックス$$! We're giving it our all too! So please!」

272:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
(I'm scared... This feeling... It's the first time since I first piloted $$マジンガー$$...)

272:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
(Back then I fought to protect $$シロー$$... to stay alive myself! It's the same now!)

272:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have no choice but to do it...! With hope as my guidepost!)

272:t_105:0.en:
$$さやか$$
(Father... $$さやか$$ may never see you again, Father...)

272:t_105:1.en:
$$さやか$$
(But I'll fight...! As long as $$甲児$$ is there, I'll put $$さやか$$'s life on the line...!)

272:t_106:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「I-I know I'm one to talk, but this is reckless!」

272:t_106:2.en:
$$ボス$$
「Sh-Shut up! We've got no choice but to do it!」

272:t_106:3.en:
$$ボス$$
(I-I'm scared out of my wits too! But still!)

272:t_106:4.en:
$$ボス$$
(You guys are so scared that your boss doesn't even get to be scared!)

272:t_107:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn...! Damn it! No matter how many times I shake it off, fear keeps welling up from the bottom of my heart!」

272:t_107:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're not the only ones I have to beat! There's the weakness inside me too!」

272:t_108:0.en:
$$隼人$$
(That was close... If I hadn't met $$ミチル$$ again, I'd have been crushed by my guilt...)

272:t_108:1.en:
$$隼人$$
(What the hell are these things...? Are they trying to break our hearts...?)

272:t_109:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
(It's true, we... I couldn't save $$武蔵$$...!)

272:t_109:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
(There were times I was nearly crushed by that regret...! But now... now that I've found something more important to do, I can fight!)

272:t_109:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
(No matter what you do, my heart won't waver! Not as long as I have my promise to $$武蔵$$!)

272:t_110:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(But I won't lose to this pain...! The vow I made with Brother... To protect the peace of this universe, I will fight!)

272:t_111:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
(It's no good... My strength is draining from my body...)

272:t_111:2.en:
$$ミカ$$
(The will to fight is draining from my heart...)

272:t_111:3.en:
$$ロゼ$$
(We can't win... Humans can't beat a god...)

272:t_111:4.en:
$$ケンジ$$
(Our fighting spirit... is breaking apart...)

272:t_111:5.en:
$$ケンジ$$
(But we'll still fight...! We still have the pride of the $$クラッシャー隊$$!)

272:t_112:1.en:
$$シモン$$
(...If I have time to regret, I look ahead... That's how I've lived... And I will from now on, too...!)
